label: NextChat
version: ChatGPTNextWeb/NextChat main@1d3dc331512929a4b1d3e82354e72acce33b5c7a (last tagged release v2.16.1, 2025-07-29; main last pushed 2026-10-20). Streaming transport: @fortaine/fetch-event-source 3.0.6.

sources.note: ChatGPTApi.path(): base URL handling. Custom endpoint = accessStore.openaiUrl when useCustomConfig is on; trailing '/' stripped; 'https://' prepended if no scheme; final URL = base + '/' + path. Client never appends '/v1' itself (the '/v1' lives in OpenaiPath).

chat(): request payload construction (keys sent by default: messages, stream, model, temperature, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty, top_p; max_tokens deliberately NOT sent except vision-named models; o1/o3/o4-mini/gpt-5 special cases).
disableListModels = true: models() returns the built-in DEFAULT_MODELS, GET /v1/models is never called (L497-L532 would be the code path if it were enabled).
Stream branch (streamWithThink with an SSE parse callback reading choices[0].delta.content / reasoning_content / tool_calls) and the non-stream branch (res.json() -> choices[0].message.content).

streamWithThink(): fetchEventSource options. onopen requires content-type text/event-stream and status 200 (else the body is shown as an error message); onmessage ignores '[DONE]' (finishes), skips empty data, JSON.parse errors are swallowed; onclose also finishes; empty final text -> 'empty response from server'. Tool-call follow-up appends {role:'assistant',tool_calls} (no content key) and {name,role:'tool',content,tool_call_id}.

Lines 19-22: headers copy; if no lowercase 'accept' key a lowercase accept: text/event-stream is added. NextChat's getHeaders() already has 'Accept' (capital) so the browser's Headers merges both into 'application/json, text/event-stream'.
getHeaders(): Content-Type application/json, Accept application/json, Authorization: Bearer <openaiApiKey> (or access code 'nk-<code>' if no key). No other custom headers.

Server proxy mode (/api/openai/*): upstream request carries only Content-Type, Cache-Control: no-store, Authorization (+ OpenAI-Organization if env set); upstream URL = BASE_URL env + '/' + path (BASE_URL without /v1).

summarizeSession(): (a) topic title request: stream:false, last historyMessageCount messages + a trailing user message with Locale.Store.Prompt.Topic; (b) memory/summary request: stream:true with a trailing role:'system' message. getSummarizeModel (L122-L152) keeps the current model unless its name starts with gpt/chatgpt/gemini/deepseek-.
getMessagesWithMemory(): default system prompt injected ONLY for model names starting 'gpt-'/'chatgpt-'; mask context prompts (system/user/assistant) + last historyMessageCount (default 4) messages.
Default modelConfig: temperature 0.5, top_p 1, max_tokens 4000 (not sent), presence_penalty 0, frequency_penalty 0, historyMessageCount 4, compressMessageLengthThreshold 1000.
VISION_MODEL_REGEXES (/vision/, /gpt-4o/, /vl/i, /o3/, /o4-mini/, /gpt-5/ ...) applied to the MODEL NAME, unanchored; a match turns on the vision code path (max_tokens added, image parts kept).
Plugin (OpenAPI) tools are sent as tools:[{type:'function',function:{name,description,parameters}}]; no tool_choice / parallel_tool_calls anywhere in the client.

Settings page auto-runs checkUsage() on open unless the endpoint contains https://api.openai.com: this fires GET <base>/dashboard/billing/usage?... and GET <base>/dashboard/billing/subscription (no /v1).
openaiUrl default is '/api/openai' in the web build (server proxy) and https://api.openai.com in the desktop app; useCustomConfig defaults to false.

setup.baseUrl: http://<gateway-host>:8787  (WITHOUT /v1 - NextChat appends 'v1/chat/completions' itself; typing '.../v1' produces '/v1/v1/chat/completions'). Settings > Custom Endpoint (toggle on) > 'OpenAI Endpoint' (must start with http(s)://). Leaving the default '/api/openai' sends the browser to NextChat's own server, which forwards to the BASE_URL environment variable (same no-/v1 rule).
setup.model: Settings > 'Custom Models' (comma separated, e.g. 'agent/sample' or '+agent/sample'), then pick it in the chat model selector. NextChat never lists remote models (disableListModels = true), so GET /v1/models is NOT requested.
setup.apiKey: Settings > 'OpenAI API Key' (sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'; if empty and server access control is on, an access code is sent as 'Bearer nk-<code>' instead).
setup.notes: Two paths: (1) default web build: browser -> /api/openai/v1/... on the NextChat server -> gateway (server-side request: upstream sees only Content-Type, Cache-Control: no-store, Authorization; body forwarded verbatim; no CORS needed). (2) custom absolute endpoint typed into the browser settings: browser calls the gateway DIRECTLY (needs CORS: preflight request headers are authorization,content-type; 'Accept' is CORS-safelisted). Docker: use host.docker.internal for the server-proxy path. Opening the Settings page fires GET /dashboard/billing/usage and /dashboard/billing/subscription at <base> (no /v1) when the endpoint is not api.openai.com; the gateway may answer 404, NextChat just shows an error in the balance row. Model-name side effects: the vision regexes are unanchored on the model name (any agent name containing 'vl', 'vision', 'o3', 'o4-mini', 'gpt-4o', 'gpt-5' ... is treated as a vision model and gets max_tokens added); names starting with o1/o3/o4-mini/gpt-5 switch to developer-role / max_completion_tokens shapes; names starting 'gpt-'/'chatgpt-' also get an injected English system prompt.

cases.title: Default streaming chat, one user message (the normal send)

evidence.note: Body keys come straight from the requestPayload literal; values from DEFAULT_CONFIG.modelConfig. max_tokens, stream_options, user, tools (undefined -> dropped by JSON.stringify) are absent. Accept header merge is from fetch-event-source (verified) + Headers semantics (browser behaviour, inferred).

cases.notes: onopen: response must be HTTP 200 AND content-type must start with 'text/event-stream' (text/plain is treated as a complete plain-text answer; anything else is rendered as an error message). Each SSE 'data:' payload is JSON.parse'd; chunks with empty/missing choices are ignored; delta.role is never read; finish_reason is never read; usage is never read; '[DONE]' ends the stream but is not required (connection close also finishes). If no text arrives at all NextChat reports 'empty response from server'. Unknown extra fields are harmless.

cases.title: Streaming chat with mask system prompt + history (system/user/assistant roles, string content)

evidence.note: Message order: [mask.context prompts] + last historyMessageCount (4) messages + new user message. Only {role, content(string)} is forwarded (openai.ts L221-L227: no name, no tool fields).

cases.notes: NextChat only uses roles system/user/assistant (never 'developer' except the o1/o3 case below, never 'tool' except the plugin follow-up case). For model names that do NOT start with gpt-/chatgpt- no extra system prompt is injected.

cases.title: Auto topic title: non-stream request, trailing user message with the title prompt

evidence.note: config = {model, stream:false, providerName}; ChatGPTApi.chat() merges app modelConfig, so temperature/penalties/top_p are still sent. getSummarizeModel returns the current model for names that do not start with gpt/chatgpt/gemini/deepseek-. The title prompt text is locale dependent (this is zh-CN; en: 'Please generate a four to five word title summarizing our conversation without any lead-in, punctuation, quotation marks, periods, symbols, bold text, or additional text. Remove enclosing quotation marks.').

messages.content: Why did the chicken cross the road? To get to the other side.
使用四到五个字直接返回这句话的简要主题，不要解释、不要标点、不要语气词、不要多余文本，不要加粗，如果没有主题，请直接返回“闲聊”

cases.notes: Fired only when enableAutoGenerateTitle is on, the topic is still the default title and the conversation is >= 50 estimated tokens (SUMMARIZE_MIN_LEN). Response handling (extractMessage): if the JSON has an 'error' key the whole JSON is rendered as the message; if it has 'data' it is treated as an image response (a chat completion must NOT contain a top-level 'data'); otherwise reads res.choices[0].message.content. The title is only applied when the HTTP status is 200 and content is non-empty. Non-stream path uses window.fetch (Accept: application/json only).

cases.title: History compression request: streaming, trailing role:system summarize instruction, max_tokens removed

evidence.note: 'const { max_tokens, ...modelcfg } = modelConfig' then api.llm.chat({messages: toBeSummarizedMsgs.concat(system Summarize prompt), config: {...modelcfg, stream: true, model, providerName}}). Summarize prompt (zh-CN) shown; en text: 'Summarize the discussion briefly in 200 words or less to use as a prompt for future context.'

messages.content: 简要总结一下对话内容，用作后续的上下文提示 prompt，控制在 200 字以内

cases.notes: Triggered after a reply when the un-summarized history exceeds compressMessageLengthThreshold (1000 estimated tokens) and sendMemory is on. NOTE the system message is LAST in the array (gateway must not require system first).

cases.title: Streaming chat when the model NAME matches a vision regex (e.g. contains 'vl'/'vision'/'o3'): adds max_tokens

evidence.note: 'if (visionModel && !isO1OrO3 && !isGpt5) requestPayload.max_tokens = Math.max(modelConfig.max_tokens, 4000)'. isVisionModel() = unanchored regex tests on the model name (app/constant.ts L478-L499; /vl/i and /o3/ also match e.g. 'agent/devlog', 'agent/demo3').

cases.notes: This is the ONLY default-settings situation in which NextChat sends max_tokens. Replay this case against an agent whose name does not match, to prove the gateway accepts max_tokens=4000 regardless.

cases.title: User message with an attached image (vision-named model): text part + image_url data URI

evidence.note: attachImages -> content: [{type:'text',text}, ...{type:'image_url', image_url:{url}}]. For a non-vision model name the images are silently dropped (getMessageTextContent) and plain string content is sent. Uploaded images are held in CacheStorage and converted to a base64 data URL by cacheImageToBase64Image (app/utils/chat.ts L96-L131); the exact data-URI prefix is the browser's compress output (inferred: data:image/jpeg;base64,...).

cases.notes: Image input (docs/images.md): the data-URL image is decoded, checked and stored as an input file of the caller, and reaches an image-capable agent (the lab fixture agent declares image input) in its provider's own image shape. A text-only agent answers 400 unsupported_content with error.param on this part instead.

cases.title: Model name starts with o1/o3/o4-mini: developer message injected, system dropped, temperature 1, max_completion_tokens

evidence.note: isO1OrO3 = model.startsWith('o1'|'o3'|'o4-mini'): role:'system' messages are dropped, {role:'developer', content:'Formatting re-enabled'} is unshifted as messages[0], temperature/top_p forced to 1, penalties forced to 0, max_completion_tokens = modelConfig.max_tokens (4000). No max_tokens key.

cases.notes: Only happens when the agent name itself starts with 'o1', 'o3' or 'o4-mini' (a 'gpt-5*' name instead keeps system/roles but sends max_completion_tokens=4000 and temperature=1 and no max_tokens). Included so the gateway proves it accepts the 'developer' role and max_completion_tokens.

cases.title: Plugin (OpenAPI tool) chat: tools array only; no tool_choice, no parallel_tool_calls

evidence.note: body = {...requestPayload, tools: tools.length ? tools : undefined}. tool objects come from app/store/plugin.ts L116-L123: {type:'function', function:{name: operationId, description, parameters: requestBody schema or {type:'object',properties:{},required:[]}}}. The concrete function names/parameters below are an illustrative OpenAPI plugin.

messages.content: What is the weather in Paris?

function.name: getWeather
function.description: Get the current weather for a city

cases.notes: Only when the active mask has plugins enabled (default: none). Streamed tool calls are read from choices[0].delta.tool_calls[0] ONLY (index 0, first element): a new tool call is recognised when tool_calls[0].id is non-empty, later fragments with no id are appended to the previous call's arguments. Parallel tool calls in one delta array are NOT supported by this parser (only element [0] is read).

cases.title: Plugin follow-up round: assistant message with tool_calls and NO content key, then a role:tool message with name

evidence.note: toolCallMessage = {role:'assistant', tool_calls:[...runTools]} (no content property at all); each result = {name, role:'tool', content (string), tool_call_id}. They are spliced onto the SAME requestPayload.messages and the request is re-sent (processToolMessage in openai.ts L387-L402). tool_calls entries are {id, type, function:{name, arguments}} copied from the streamed delta.

messages.content: What is the weather in Paris?

function.name: getWeather
function.description: Get the current weather for a city

cases.notes: Risk: the assistant tool_calls message has no 'content' field (not null, not ''), and the tool message carries an extra 'name' field. A strict gateway validator that requires content on assistant messages will reject this.

cases.title: CORS preflight when the browser calls the gateway directly (custom absolute endpoint in settings)

evidence.note: Request headers set by the client: Content-Type: application/json (not CORS-safelisted -> triggers preflight), Accept (safelisted), Authorization (when a key is set). A browser lists the non-safelisted ones, lowercase and sorted: authorization,content-type.

cases.notes: Only needed in the direct-browser setup (absolute URL typed into 'OpenAI Endpoint'). The default web path via /api/openai is server-to-server and needs no CORS. 204 is the more common preflight status; 200 listed per the test-lab convention. The actual POST response must also carry Access-Control-Allow-Origin.
